description: This file defines data classes, enums, and constants related to checkpoint metadata management in PyTorch distributed training, including tensor properties, storage metadata, and indexing structures.

classes.name: ChunkStorageMetadata
classes.description: Represents metadata for a chunk of tensor storage, including offsets and sizes.

classes.name: _MEM_FORMAT_ENCODING
classes.description: Enum describing the memory format of a tensor.

classes.name: TensorProperties
classes.description: Holds properties used to create a tensor, including dtype, layout, requires_grad, memory_format, and pin_memory.

classes.name: TensorStorageMetadata
classes.description: Contains tensor properties, size, and associated chunks.

classes.name: BytesStorageMetadata
classes.description: Placeholder class for byte storage metadata.

classes.name: StorageMeta
classes.description: Metadata about storage, including checkpoint IDs and modules.

classes.name: Metadata
classes.description: Represents checkpoint metadata, including state dict, planner data, storage data, and version.

classes.name: MetadataIndex
classes.description: A lookup key for items in a state dict or Metadata, including fully qualified name, offset, and index.

methods.name: TensorProperties.__getstate__
methods.description: Serializes tensor properties, encoding memory format.

methods.name: TensorProperties.__setstate__
methods.description: Deserializes tensor properties, decoding memory format.

methods.name: TensorProperties.create_from_tensor
methods.description: Creates TensorProperties from a torch.Tensor instance.
